name: PV-8
summary: Stimulant of the pyrrolidinophenone class that is a higher homologue of α-PHP. Reportedly less potent and less effects.

uses.text: α-Pyrrolidinoheptaphenone (PV8, α-PEP, α-PHPP, Aphpp, A-PHPP) is a designer drug of the pyrrolidinophenone class of cathinones.

summaryZh: α-吡咯烷基苯庚酮（英語：α-Pyrrolidinoheptaphenone，縮寫：α-PEP、α-PHPP，或稱為：1-苯基-2-(N-吡咯烷基)-1-庚酮、PV8）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C17H25NO，屬於卡西酮衍生物，2015年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

pharmacology.en: It is thought to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline, like other pyrrolidinophenone cathinones such as α-PVP.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和 α-PVP 等其他吡咯烷苯酮類卡西酮一樣，會阻斷多巴胺和正腎上腺素的再回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和 α-PVP 等其他吡咯烷苯酮类卡西酮一样，会阻断多巴胺和正肾上腺素的再回收。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cathinones of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and paranoia, and often lead to compulsive redosing. Serious risks include seizures and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類合成卡西酮可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠和偏執，也常導致強迫性追加。嚴重風險包括癲癇發作和血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类合成卡西酮可能引起心跳过快、高血压、体温过高、焦虑、失眠和偏执，也常导致强迫性追加。严重风险包括癫痫发作和血清素症候群。

fact.en: PV-8 is α-PVP with its carbon chain lengthened by two carbons, and one carbon longer than α-PHP.
fact.zh: PV-8 是把 α-PVP 的碳鏈延長兩個碳，比 α-PHP 多一個碳。
fact.zhHans: PV-8 是把 α-PVP 的碳链延长两个碳，比 α-PHP 多一个碳。
